name: bohmian · Wyrd
description: Canonical token source for the Wyrd design system under the bohmian brand. Edit here, then run `node brand/gen-theme.mjs` to regenerate theme.css. Consumed directly by agents/A2UI; the human/visual reference is DESIGN.md + ./renders/styleguide.html. Derived from .dev/assets/bohmian/bohmian-brand-mockups-v4.html (approved).

--bg.role: page / main background — warm paper on light, blue-cast near-black on dark

--border.role: 2px ink borders (always present, never hairline). Dark stays quiet (~2:1 on surface) — visible structure without light-mode ink loudness

--text.role: body text — LOCKED for readability (~17:1 light, ~14:1 dark). Do not re-tune.

--brand.role: brand blue fill (button/chip), panel top-bar. Collapses onto --brand-strong in light and onto --brand-soft in dark; the tokens stay distinct because their roles differ per mode.

--brand-strong.role: links, selected refs, big stats, llm span kind, heat ramp

--brand-soft.role: selection / hover row wash, panel backgrounds

--lime.role: secondary accent — the second voice after brand blue. Secondary action fills, the client/runtime plane, and secondary emphasis. Bright lime is a FILL only; it is 1.30:1 on white and can never be text or a thin bar there.

--lime-ink.role: text on lime fills (both modes — safe because --lime is mode-invariant)

--lime-text.role: lime as text or as a thin bar: raw lime on dark, darkened lime on light. 5.15:1 on white.

--client.role: the Line — client/runtime plane. This IS lime, mode-split so it survives a light surface (5.15:1 on white vs 1.30:1 for raw lime).

--client-bar.role: client/agent kind left-bar + indicators. 2.03:1 luminance separation from --server-bar amber.

--server-bar.role: server/tool kind left-bar + indicators (darkened on light)

--control-bar.role: control/retrieval kind left-bar + indicators (darkened on light). Steel blue: near brand blue but never a stand-in for brand identity.

--ok.role: healthy / pass / success — FILL and bar use only

--warn.role: drift / caution / warning — FILL and bar use only

--danger.role: fail / error / removed (overrides kind) — FILL and bar use only

--ok-text.role: healthy AS TEXT. Raw --ok is 3.01:1 as a badge label on light; this is the darkest hue-preserving value clearing 4.5:1. Dark mode already passes, so it is unchanged there.

--warn-text.role: caution AS TEXT. Raw --warn is 2.28:1 as a badge label on light. Also decouples warning text from --server-bar, which shares --warn's hex.

--danger-text.role: failure AS TEXT. Raw --danger is 3.94:1 as a badge label on light.

--r.role: radius — locked at 5px (true circles only for dots/avatars)

$pairs: Contrast contract, asserted by gen-theme.mjs in BOTH modes. Every foreground/background pairing the system actually renders is declared here so a palette edit that breaks one fails the build instead of shipping. `fill` may be a token name or {mix:[a,b],pct} for a color-mix() background. `min` is the WCAG floor for the role: 4.5 for text, 3.0 for non-text UI (WCAG 1.4.11), 7.0 where we hold ourselves to AAA. The reason this exists: --ink-on-fill and --lime-ink are mode-INVARIANT, so they are only safe on a mode-invariant fill; and --brand collapses onto --brand-btn-ink in dark (1.23:1) while looking fine in light (6.77:1).

pairs.role: neutral badge label — untinted; a 12% --muted tint lands at 4.46:1 in dark, and 'neutral' means no status, so it gets no fill
server kind bar (non-text) — 2.54:1, inherited; see DESIGN.md
